name: tgrep
description: Search with tgrep (Microsoft's trigram-indexed, ripgrep-compatible grep) instead of the Grep tool: a SessionStart hook keeps a `tgrep serve` running for the repository (never double-serving, stopped when the last session leaves), a search skill that loads live index/server state and gets the command shape, scoping and freshness right, and a hook skill to disable, exclude a repo, or stop a server.
